Shipping.title: Time And Shipping
Shipping.bannerIntro: At Pow Flick, we strive to deliver your customized uniforms as quickly and efficiently as possible.
Shipping.bannerLead: Here’s everything you need to know about our production and shipping timelines.
Shipping.fastReliable: Fast, Reliable Delivery for Your Custom Uniforms
Shipping.fastReliableBody: At Pow Flick, we know how important timely delivery is when it comes to your custom uniforms. That’s why we’ve streamlined our production and shipping processes to get your orders to you as quickly and efficiently as possible. Below, you’ll find everything you need to know about production times, shipping options, and how to track your order from start to finish.
Shipping.productionTimeBody: All our products are made-to-order, ensuring top quality and personalization. The production process typically takes 30 days, depending on the complexity of your order and seasonal demand.
Shipping.shippingTimesBody: Once production is complete, your order will be shipped according to the following estimated delivery times:
Shipping.shippingTimesList1: USA, European Union, Mexico: 10–20 business days
Shipping.shippingTimesList2: Other destinations: Shipping times may vary depending on the country
Shipping.expressShippingBody: Need your order faster? We offer an Express Shipping option for an additional $20 USD, reducing delivery time to approximately 15 days. This service is available at checkout and uses trusted carriers like DHL and FedEx.
Shipping.trackingBody: Once your order is shipped, you’ll receive a tracking number via email so you can monitor your delivery in real-time.
Shipping.customsBody: For international shipments, customs duties and taxes may apply depending on your country’s regulations. These charges are the responsibility of the customer, and the relevant customs authorities will contact you if needed.
Shipping.questionsBody: If you have any questions about your order or delivery times, feel free to reach out to us at support@powflick.com.

ReturnRefund.title: Return & Refund Policy
ReturnRefund.intro1: At Powflick, we understand how important it is for you and your team to have a uniform that truly represents you. That’s why every order is unique, and we treat it as such. We take quality very seriously, from material selection to the final print, including manual quality control, piece by piece. To ensure everything is perfect, we’ll keep you informed at every step, even sending you a sample of the printed fabric for you to confirm the colors and design before final production. All of this is backed by our 10+ years of experience.
ReturnRefund.intro2: We know that sometimes, very rarely, things may not go as expected. Although we work with personalized products, if there is a genuine problem with your order, we are here to help! Please read our policy below so you know what to do.
ReturnRefund.cancellationsIntro: We understand that unforeseen circumstances may arise. Here’s our cancellation policy:
ReturnRefund.cancellationFree: Free Cancellation: If you need to cancel your order shortly after placing it, you can do so free of charge within the first 2 hours.
ReturnRefund.cancellationFee: Cancellation with Fee: If you request cancellation after the first 2 hours, but before your order enters the production phase, a 10% charge of the total order value will be applied to cover administrative costs.
ReturnRefund.cancellationNot: Cancellation Not Possible: Once your order has entered the production phase, it can no longer be canceled due to its personalized nature.
ReturnRefund.cancellationHowBody: To request a cancellation, contact support@powflick.com including your order number and reason.
ReturnRefund.returnsGeneralBody: Because we make each product in a personalized way, following your specific designs and instructions, we do not accept returns of customized products, except in the cases detailed below.
ReturnRefund.returnsConditionsIntro: Returns will only be considered in the following cases:
ReturnRefund.returnsCond1: Serious Manufacturing Defect: If the product has a manufacturing defect that prevents its normal use.
ReturnRefund.returnsCond2: Serious Error in Customization: If there is a substantial difference between the product received and the approved design/instructions.
ReturnRefund.exclusionsIntro: Returns will not be accepted for:
ReturnRefund.exclusion1: Minor errors or variations that do not significantly affect appearance or functionality.
ReturnRefund.exclusion2: Disagreement with the design if the sample was previously approved.
ReturnRefund.exclusion3: Damage caused by misuse, improper care, or normal wear and tear.
ReturnRefund.claimPeriodBody: You have 7 business days from the date of receipt to file a claim.
ReturnRefund.claimHowBody: Contact support@powflick.com, indicate your order number, detailed description, and attach clear photos showing the defect or error.
ReturnRefund.claimEvalBody: Our team will review your claim and evidence. We may reject claims that lack evidence or don’t meet conditions.
ReturnRefund.claimRes1: We will provide instructions to proceed.
ReturnRefund.claimRes2: Powflick covers shipping costs for the return.
ReturnRefund.claimRes3: Modification or Reshipment: We may modify or send a new product quickly.
ReturnRefund.claimRes4: Replacement: If modification isn’t possible, a replacement is sent at no cost.
ReturnRefund.claimRes5: Refund: If none of the above is possible, a full or partial refund will be issued via the original payment method (processing time 5 business days after inspection; funds may appear within 7–15 days).
ReturnRefund.unavailableBody: If a product you ordered is unavailable or can’t be customized, we will notify you and refund the amount paid.
ReturnRefund.pricingBody: If there is a price error, we’ll contact you to reconfirm or cancel. If unreachable, the order is canceled and fully refunded.
ReturnRefund.contactIntro: For questions or assistance regarding this policy:
ReturnRefund.contactResponse: Response Time: We aim to reply within 24 hours (Mon–Fri).
ReturnRefund.changesBody: We may modify this Return & Refund Policy. Continued use of our services after updates implies acceptance.

section2.title: 2. ORDER PROCESS AND PRODUCT CUSTOMIZATION
section2.content:
2.1 Product Selection

The customer must choose the type of uniform they wish to customize.

2.2 Design Customization

Size and Gender: The customer selects the sizes (e.g., XS to 3XL) and genders (men, women, children).

Customizable Elements - Logos: The customer must upload their own logos in vector format (SVG, AI, EPS, PDF). If no vector file is available, the logo must be sent in the highest possible resolution (300 dpi). The customer is responsible for ensuring that images are of good quality, with a minimum size of 400×400 px and a minimum file size of 300 KB. Logos may also be sent by email to support@powflick.com. Powflick does not guarantee optimal print quality if low-resolution images are provided.

Texts and Numbers: The customer may add names, slogans, or numbers to the front and back of the uniform.

Materials: The customer will select from the predefined material mockups available for each type of sport. Powflick offers a default material at no additional cost, plus two other options at +$2.99 each.

Additional Cost: Each customization variable (logos, text, numbers, material selection) has an associated additional cost: +$4.99 per logo +$3.99 per additional text or number +$2.99 if choosing a material different from the default.

2.3 Preview

The customer can access a design preview under the “list” option found beneath each customization, by clicking the “View” button. A PDF file will be generated, summarizing all customizations.

2.4 Add to Cart

Once satisfied with the design, the customer adds the uniform to their shopping cart.

2.5 Summary and Confirmation

The customer can view the costs of each customization throughout the process. Before confirming the order, the customer reviews the summary. After the purchase, they receive PDF files with details of the customization via email.

2.6 Order Cancellation

The customer has a 2-hour window after placing the order to cancel without any fees. If cancellation is requested after 2 hours, 10% of the total order value will be withheld for management costs. The customer must contact support@powflick.com to request cancellation.

2.7 Product Availability

If a product is no longer available or cannot be customized, Powflick will inform the customer and proceed with a refund of the amount paid.

section3.title: 3. PRICES, PAYMENTS, AND TRANSACTIONS
section3.content:
3.1 Product and Service Prices

The prices of products and services will be those indicated on the website, except in cases of obvious error. In the event of a pricing error, Powflick will notify the customer as soon as possible, allowing them to confirm the order at the correct price or cancel it. Powflick is not obliged to supply a product at a lower price if it was incorrectly listed. The listed prices do not include taxes corresponding to the customer’s country, which are calculated based on the shipping location (particularly in the United States).

3.2 Payment Methods

Powflick accepts credit card payments (Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, American Express) and through payment gateways such as Stripe.

3.3 Discounts and Promotions

Occasionally, Powflick may offer promotional discounts via codes that the customer can apply at checkout.

3.4 Additional Costs

Powflick does not apply additional handling or customization fees beyond those indicated by the customer when selecting each uniform variable.

3.5 Transaction Security

All transactions on Powflick’s website are encrypted to protect the customer’s sensitive data. Powflick works with recognized payment gateways to ensure the protection of financial information. Powflick does not store transaction information about its customers.

section4.title: 4. BRAND, IMAGE, AND PROMOTION RIGHTS
section4.content:
4.1 Placement of Logos and Labels

Powflick reserves the right to include its own logo on products, as shown in the sample designs. The customer agrees that Powflick’s logo is positioned so that it does not interfere with the customer’s logos and respects the overall aesthetic of the design.

4.2 Use of Products and Information

Powflick reserves the right to use any communication from the customer (including images and comments) for marketing and promotional purposes. This includes displaying products on the website, in catalogs, and on social media. By using these services, the customer agrees that Powflick may edit, copy, publish, distribute, and use shared content with no obligation of confidentiality, compensation, or response. Powflick is not responsible for any content uploaded or shared by the customer or third parties.

4.3 Customers as References

Powflick may use its customers as references, mentioning their names, logos, or images for advertising or promotional purposes. The customer may limit or prohibit the use of their information by notifying Powflick in writing.

section5.title: 5. ACCEPTABLE USE OF CONTENT AND INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
section5.content:
5.1 Customer Liability for Content

The customer declares and guarantees that they are the legitimate owner or hold the necessary usage rights over any image, text, logo, brand, or other element they provide to Powflick for product customization. By uploading or submitting content, the customer confirms compliance with applicable intellectual property laws and commits to not infringe the rights of third parties.

5.2 Prohibited Content and Review

Powflick reserves the right to refuse, review, or remove any order containing content that, in its sole discretion, is considered a violation of intellectual property rights, fundamental rights, or any content that is offensive, illegal, etc.

5.3 Use of Trademarks

If the customer uses a trademark, they declare they have the express authorization of the rightful owner. The customer assumes full responsibility and expressly exonerates Powflick from any claim or dispute arising from the unauthorized use of said trademark.

5.4 Disclaimer

Powflick assumes no liability for legal, financial, or any other consequences resulting from unauthorized use or infringement of third-party rights by the customer. The customer agrees to indemnify and hold Powflick harmless from any claim, demand, loss, damage, expense, or cost arising from the improper use of the content provided. The customer will be solely responsible for any seizure or confiscation of products resulting from copyright infringement or any other applicable law.

section10.title: 10. PRODUCTION PROCESS
section10.content:
10.1 Definition

“Production” refers to the period from placing the order to the point at which products are handed over to the carrier for shipment. Shipping time is not included in this period.

10.2 Start of the Process

Production will not begin until all outstanding payments (if any) have been paid in full.

10.3 Modifications

Once an order enters the production phase, it cannot be modified.

10.4 Design and Color Confirmation

Approximately 8 days after placing the order, Powflick will send the customer a fabric sample of the logos, names, and numbers for one of the uniforms in the order, via email and WhatsApp. The customer will have 24 hours to respond and confirm or request changes. If no response is received, the sample is considered accepted.

10.5 Delivery Times

Powflick provides an approximate delivery date. The customer acknowledges that this is an estimation unless an EXPRESS service with a mandatory delivery timeframe is contracted.

section11.title: 11. DELIVERY TIMES
section11.content:
11.1 Estimated Nature of Timeframes

Delivery times provided by Powflick are estimates, not guarantees.

11.2 Approximate Production Times

The production time for a custom order is typically around 30 days. The customer can check the status of the order via the customer portal.

11.3 Production Process (Summary)

Processing: Checking the files. Production Queue: Waiting times vary. Printing: The design is printed and transferred onto fabric. Tailoring: Pieces are sewn. Review: Final inspection before shipping.

11.4 Shipping (Transit) Times

Once production is finished, shipping times vary by country (e.g., 10–20 business days for US/EU/MX).

11.5 Express Shipping

An Express Shipping option is available for an additional $20, reducing delivery times to ~15 days in most cases.

11.6 Customs Duties

For international shipments, customs duties and taxes may apply, which are the customer’s responsibility.

section12.title: 12. RETURNS AND CLAIMS
section12.content:
12.1 Customized Products

Powflick offers made-to-measure, customized products; no returns are allowed unless otherwise stated here.

12.2 Claims for Defects or Obvious Errors

Powflick will be liable for manufacturing defects that render the product unusable, or serious errors in customization.

12.3 Claims Procedure

The customer must contact Powflick within 7 business days of receiving the product, providing a description and photos.

12.4 Conditions for Accepting Claims

The customer must provide clear, detailed photographic evidence. Claims can be rejected if caused by misuse or if errors are minor.

12.5 Return Shipping Costs

If Powflick accepts a return due to a defect or obvious error, it will cover return shipping and replacement costs.

Faq.heroTitle: We want your experience to be perfect!
Faq.heroSubtitle: Here you'll find answers to the most common questions about orders, payments, and shipping. If anything’s unclear, just reach out — we’re here to help!

orders.title: Orders & Customization
orders.q1Title: How can I customize my uniform?
orders.q1Content: Select the type of uniform, choose sizes and genders, and add your logos, texts, or numbers. Upload logos in vector format (SVG, AI, EPS, PDF) or high resolution (minimum 300 dpi).
orders.q2Title: What file types can I upload for logos?
orders.q2Content: We recommend vector files (SVG, AI, EPS, PDF). If you don't have these formats, send the highest resolution image possible. We can’t guarantee optimal print quality if the file doesn’t meet our requirements.
orders.q3Title: Can I see a preview before confirming my order?
orders.q3Content: Yes, once you complete your customization, you can generate a PDF file with a preview of your design.
orders.q4Title: Can I modify or cancel my order after purchasing?
orders.q4Content: You have up to 2 hours after placing your order to cancel it free of charge. After that, if the order is already in production, no changes can be made, and a 10% fee will apply for cancellations.

payments.title: Prices & Payments
payments.q5Title: What payment methods do you accept?
payments.q5Content: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, American Express) and payments via Stripe.
payments.q6Content: No, taxes are calculated at checkout based on the shipping location.
payments.q7Title: Do you offer discounts or promotions?
payments.q7Content: Yes, we occasionally offer promotional codes and discounts. Stay tuned to our social media and newsletters!

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.q8Title: How long will it take to receive my order?
shipping.q8Content: Production takes about 30 days. Shipping times vary depending on the destination: USA, European Union, and Mexico: 10–20 business days. Other destinations: Shipping times may vary depending on the country.
shipping.q9Content: Yes, for an additional $20 USD, you can select express shipping at checkout. This service reduces delivery time to approximately 15 days.
shipping.q10Title: Do I have to pay customs duties or taxes?
shipping.q10Content: Yes, customs duties and taxes are the customer's responsibility and vary by country.

returns.title: Returns & Claims
returns.q11Title: Can I return a customized product?
returns.q11Content: Since our products are made to order, we don’t accept returns unless there’s a manufacturing defect or an obvious error.
returns.q12Title: What should I do if I receive a defective or incorrect product?
returns.q12Content: Contact us within 7 business days of receiving your product by emailing support@powflick.com with a detailed description and photos of the issue.
returns.q13Title: Who covers the shipping costs for returns?
returns.q13Content: If we accept the return due to a defect or error, Pow Flick will cover the return shipping costs and the cost of shipping a replacement.

contact.contactQuestion1: How can I get in touch with Pow Flick?
